Elena V.: Quick thread from today's all-hands Q&A on GTM/partnerships — capturing clarifications and next steps.
Marco B.: Short answers: 1) Renewal triage window = next 90 days, prioritize accounts > $30k ARR or flagged "exec_risk". 2) Partner-led vs self-serve: keep partner-led for strategic ISVs/referrals; continue bottoms-up for trials. 3) Co-sell credits: we'll report influenced pipeline and attributed wins separately.
Tara S.: Ops/RevOps — which CRM view and fields should sales pull for the renewal deck?
ops-bot: Use saved view "renewals_triage_q3". Fields: account_name, ARR, renewal_date, exec_contact, product_health_flag, partner_referral. Nightly export to /ops/renewals.
Elena V.: Routing question: if partner-originated opp scales > $150k, keep partner-managed during Q3 pilot unless overlap with named AE. We'll revisit in Oct.
Marco B.: Metrics: Marketing tracks # influenced pipeline; RevOps tracks attributed closed-won for comp. Q3 targets: +20% influenced, 5 attributed partner-sourced closes.
Tara S.: PS ask: will partner PoCs be prioritized? last cycle timing slipped.
Marco B.: PS will reserve capacity for partner-coordinated PoCs and publish an SLA this week.
Elena V.: Action items: 1) Ops -> upload renewal deck template and nightly export (due Mon 09:00 PT). 2) Partnerships -> share partner enablement checklist and pilot invite list (due Wed). 3) RevOps -> confirm attribution rules for comp (due Fri). 4) Sales -> tag #partners early and set partner_source on close.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: upload renewal deck template by Mon 09:00 PT.
Tara S.: Thanks all  will prep at-risk list and ping ops.
Elena V.: I'll compile and send a one-page summary to leadership after noon. Reply here with objections or additions.
